## Description

Unpacks `<project>.zip` into `<project>/` and then deletes the ZIP to free disk space (Bitbucket stops steps that run out of disk). Existing files are not overwritten (`unzip -n`). If unpacking fails, the ZIP is kept.

After that, if `<project>/` contains between one and five ZIP files at its top level, they are unpacked into `<project>/` as well, and their names are written to `<project>/.zipfile_info` as `ZIPFILE_SUFFIX` for later scripts. ZIP files inside `<project>/` are part of the deposit and are never deleted.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/00_unpack_zip.sh [--keep-zip] [project]
```

- `--keep-zip` - Keep `<project>.zip` after unpacking. The Download step of `1-populate-from-icpsr` uses it, because the ZIP is moved into `cache/` for the parallel steps.
- `project` - Deposit directory name. When omitted, it is read from `config.yml` through `tools/resolve_project_id.sh`.
